meta.parties: Uthumalevai Et Al v. Avva Umma

rules.statement: Where a Muslim father donates immovable property to his minor child, possession of the property by the father is deemed to be possession on behalf of the donee.
rules.supporting_quote: It is clear law that where a Muslim father donates his property of his minor child, no transmutation of possession is necessary, and the possession by the father would be regarded as possession on behalf of the donee.
